rules.retrieved_snippet: Fetched Normattiva page: title 'Codice in materia di protezione dei dati personali, recante disposizioni per l'adeguamento dell'ordinamento nazionale al regolamento (UE) n. 2016/679', D.Lgs. n. 196 of 30 June 2003 (GU n. 174, 29-07-2003, SO n. 123); art. 1 (Oggetto) begins 'Il trattamento dei dati personali avviene secondo le norme del' Regulation (EU) 2016/679.

rules.source: Legge 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 — Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale — https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2025/09/25/223/sg/pdf ; https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/2025/09/25/25G00143/CONSOLIDATED
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (official URLs listed, secondary commentary read): published in Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 223 of 25 September 2025, in force 10 October 2025; art. 1 sets principles for research, development, adoption and use of AI systems and models with a human-centred approach; art. 2 links definitions to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; framework law delegating powers to the Government, with sector provisions (professions, public administration, justice, copyright, criminal law). Law is in force, not a bill.

rules.source: Codice penale, art. 615-ter (accesso abusivo a un sistema informatico o telematico; introduced by Legge 547/1993) — https://www.brocardi.it/codice-penale/libro-secondo/titolo-xii/capo-iii/art615ter.html
rules.retrieved_snippet: Secondary-source search summary (Brocardi and commentary; Normattiva page not retrieved): punishes entering a protected computer/telematic system without authorisation or remaining against the holder's will; base penalty up to three years' imprisonment; aggravated cases two to ten years; introduced by Law 547 of 1993.
